settings.title: Settings
settings.foldersHelp: Valet organizes only the files in these folders.
settings.autoApply: Apply rules automatically in watched folders
settings.autoApplyHelp: New files are organized without a preview. It starts only after you have approved a preview.
settings.autoApplyLocked: Available after you approve your first preview.
settings.folderDuplicate: The folder is already in the list.
settings.invalidHelp: Some folders in the list are not watched. Remove them to change the list.
settings.newFolderNotice: The new folder is organized automatically only after an approved preview.
settings.unavailableReason: Unavailable right now (for example, a disconnected drive). Resumes automatically when it is back.
settings.versionUnknown: The installed version could not be read.
settings.channelHelp: Beta gets new versions earlier, before they are marked stable.
settings.updatePrivacy: Valet connects to the internet for updates only when you click “Check now” and once a day, for the automatic check. No file names or paths are sent.
settings.installConfirm: Valet will restart. No operation is interrupted: the installation waits for the running batch.
settings.debugLoggingHelp: May contain file paths. Stays on your computer.

config.driveRoot: You cannot watch a whole drive. Pick a folder, for example Downloads.
config.excludedFolder: This folder is excluded by default or is inside an excluded folder (Windows, Program Files, ProgramData, AppData, .git, node_modules, target and others). Pick another folder.
config.noFolders: No watched folder exists on disk. Add one in Settings.
config.io: The configuration could not be read or saved.

rule.invalidOptions: The rule options are not valid.
rule.storage: Rules could not be read or saved.

settings.invalidChannel: The update channel is not valid. Choose Stable or Beta.

update.busy: Waiting for the running batch to finish.

rules.description: Rules say which files go where. They apply only in watched folders.
rules.emptyText: Add a rule so Valet knows what to organize.

conditionHelp.duplicate: Files with identical content. The oldest copy is kept. The action can only be "To Recycle Bin" or "Report only".

actionHelp.trash: Files go to the Recycle Bin, where they can be restored. Valet never deletes permanently.
actionHelp.report: Files are listed in the preview under "Reports". Nothing moves.

editorError.days: Enter a whole number of days, 0 to 36500.
editorError.noConditions: Add at least one condition or check "Applies to all files".
